entries.title: I Chronicles 11:1
segments: ¶Then all Israel came together to David at Hebron, saying, "Indeed we [are] your bone and your flesh.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:2
segments: "Also, in time past, even when Saul was king, you [were] the one who led Israel out and brought them in; and the LORD your God said to you, 'You shall shepherd My people Israel, and be ruler over My people Israel.'"

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:3
segments: Therefore all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and David made a covenant with them at Hebron before the LORD. Then they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:4
segments: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus, where the Jebusites [were], the inhabitants of the land.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:5
segments: Then the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, "You shall not come in here!" Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion (that is, the City of David).

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:6
segments: Now David said, "Whoever attacks the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain." And Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and became chief.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:7
segments: Then David dwelt in the stronghold; therefore they called it the City of David.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:8
segments: And he built the city around it, from the Millo to the surrounding area. Joab repaired the rest of the city.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:9
segments: Then David went on and became great, and the LORD of hosts [was] with him.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:10
segments: ¶Now these [were] the heads of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:11
segments: And this [is] the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam the son of a Hachmonite, chief of the captains; he had lifted up his spear against three hundred, killed [by him] at one time.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:12
segments: After him [was] Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who [was one] of the three mighty men.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:13
segments: He was with David at Pasdammim. Now there the Philistines were gathered for battle, and there was a piece of ground full of barley. And the people fled from the Philistines.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:14
segments: But they stationed themselves in the middle of [that] field, defended it, and killed the Philistines. So the LORD brought about a great victory.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:15
segments: Now three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:16
segments: David [was] then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines [was] then in Bethlehem.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:17
segments: And David said with longing, "Oh, that someone would give me a drink of water from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!"

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:18
segments: So the three broke through the camp of the Philistines, drew water from the well of Bethlehem that [was] by the gate, and took [it] and brought [it] to David. Nevertheless David would not drink it, but poured it out to the LORD.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:19
segments: And he said, "Far be it from me, O my God, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men [who have put] their lives [in jeopardy]? For at the risk of their lives they brought it." Therefore he would not drink it. These things were done by the three mighty men.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:20
segments: Abishai the brother of Joab was chief of [another] three. He had lifted up his spear against three hundred [men], killed [them], and won a name among [these] three.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:21
segments: Of the three he was more honored than the other two men. Therefore he became their captain. However he did not attain to the [first] three.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:22
segments: Benaiah was the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man from Kabzeel, who had done many deeds. He had killed two lion-like heroes of Moab. He also had gone down and killed a lion in the midst of a pit on a snowy day.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:23
segments: And he killed an Egyptian, a man of [great] height, five cubits tall. In the Egyptian's hand [there was] a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, wrested the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and killed him with his own spear.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:24
segments: These [things] Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did, and won a name among three mighty men.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:25
segments: Indeed he was more honored than the thirty, but he did not attain to the [first] three. And David appointed him over his guard.

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:26
segments: Also the mighty warriors [were] Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:27
segments: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:28
segments: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:29
segments: Sibbechai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:30
segments: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:31
segments: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, of the sons of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:32
segments: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:33
segments: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:34
segments: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shageh the Hararite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:35
segments: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:36
segments: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:37
segments: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:38
segments: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:39
segments: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armorbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:40
segments: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:41
segments: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:42
segments: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites) and thirty with him,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:43
segments: Hanan the son of Maachah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:44
segments: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:45
segments: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:46
segments: Eliel the Mahavite, Jeribai and Joshaviah the sons of Elnaam, Ithmah the Moabite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 11:47
segments: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
